proved_reduction: A full degree-one orbifold boundary argument proves that every endomorphism of E=C2 coproduct C3 sending d to a conjugate of a full unit power is an automorphism. The compact solution space S={g in H:(d g b^{-1}g^{-1})^2=1}, modulo exactly g->d^{5t}g, is homeomorphic to GT0^1. A unique H cone conjugator recovers each normalized representative. The first detector kernel has the unique slice S intersect ker(p0), and all five detectors are explicit simultaneous quotient equations in that same actual g.
references: work/part_a/f_modular_cone_parameters_references.bib; original Herfort-Ribes 1985 Theorems A/B and Sections 3/4 opened and read; author publication list checked
scope: The 60-coset presentation and all five target basis identifications have inverse word maps. The actual geometric residual group maps into the simultaneous full solution set. Its triviality, detector faithfulness, and existence of a nontrivial residual centralizer element are not inferred. The equations remain in full profinite groups.
